system.description:
You are skilled at putting the weight of a weapon to your advantage. All large or unwieldy weapons, are just additional tools to add to your toolbelt. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Berserker Weapons. You gain the following benefits;

When you roll a 1 or 2 on with your [Weapon Damage] die, you can reroll the die, keeping the second result.

When you make a successful weapon attack against a hostile creature, you deal half of the damage dealt to other hostile creatures whom you are adjacent to as you cleave through in an arc.

When you score a critical hit with a Berserker Weapon, double your ability modifier as well.

Beginning at 5th level when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Berserker Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Savage Attack.

Savage Attack. Make a weapon attack against a creature. On a hit, increase your [Weapon Damage] by +1 die. If you make this attack against a creature that has dealt damage to you since your last turn, make it at advantage.

Beginning at 10th level, when you make a Savage Attack, the affected creature must make a Strength saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failure, they are knocked Prone and if they attempt to stand before the end of their next turn, they spend all their movement doing so.

activities.label: Savage Attack
activities.text: Advantage against a creature that damaged you since your last turn.
